bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears improved to 5-2 after a Thursday night victory over the Patriots, but the win came at a cost as Cole Kmet is officially out for the season with a knee injury , with the club placing him on Reserve/Injured. Head coach Ben Johnson has since said he has no regrets about a trick play used in the win, while the team now turns its attention to a Week 8 matchup against the Seahawks, where they've reportedly opened as underdogs.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The biggest Detroit Lions story from the last day centers on All-Pro safety Kerby Joseph, who hasn't played in a game in more than a year and has spent the first seven weeks of the 2026 season on the Physically Unable to Perform list , returning to practice Wednesday as coach Dan Campbell started his 21-day evaluation window. The Lions cleared Joseph to practice, giving the team 21 days to decide whether to put the 2024 All-Pro safety on the active roster or on season-ending injured reserve, with Campbell calling it "a step in the right direction" as Detroit prepares to face the Minnesota Vikings this Sunday.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers released their final injury report ahead of Thursday night's Week 8 matchup against the Carolina Panthers, ruling out two starters, including linebacker Zaire Franklin and center Sean Rhyan, while several other players are listed as questionable for Thursday Night Football. With key linemen sidelined, Green Bay faces an offensive line puzzle with Travis Glover and Sean Rhyan ruled out, leaving the team with nine healthy linemen and only eight spots available on gameday, though there's optimism that Kevin Zeitler could finally get his shot at right guard.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Aaron Jones sat out Wednesday's practice with a knee injury ahead of the Vikings' Week 8 matchup against the Lions, though head coach Kevin O'Connell offered an encouraging update on the veteran's recovery, suggesting he still has a realistic chance to play Sunday . The injury news comes as speculation continues about Minnesota's interest in Indianapolis Colts running back Jonathan Taylor, whose future has become a major storyline ahead of the NFL's November 10 trade deadline .
